prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production animation cels, faithful 4x HD redraw of Sam & Max Hit the Road.
Input1 is the original six-pose sheet, authoritative for every silhouette, proportion, position and pose. Input2 is the approved Sam identity and line-quality master, NOT a replacement pose.
Redraw exactly SIX Sam dog detective poses in the SAME 3 columns x2 rows. Match the originals: blue-gray fedora and suit, orange-brown face/paws/feet, large black nose, white shirt and cuffs, black tie with broad blue diagonal stripes. Keep Sam stout, head at source size, no enlarged eyes. Smooth dark cartoon outlines, flat original colors, one restrained shade, a few highlights; no texture, fur, gradients, 3D, shadows or pixel staircases.
Specific sequence: Sam reaches to switch an office TV on/off, no prop in his hands. Panel1 hand rests near belly; panel2 begins extending a relaxed hand; panel3 long arm forward to screen-right, fingers relaxed/pointing; panel4 long arm forward, fist closes to touch switch; panel5 fingers extend again; panel6 hand relaxed down by his side. Other hand stays low at screen-right side. Preserve exact lean, muzzle/hat angle, each finger, cuff and feet. All face screen-right. Do not add a TV, background, extra hands or duplicate characters.
Output six separate complete unclipped drawings with generous transparent margins, same panel order, no labels/grid/text. Placement targets: panels1/2 152x280px, panel3 240x268px, panel4 248x268px, panel5 240x268px, panel6 160x280px. True alpha-zero transparent background, no gray, checkerboard, white or magenta background or fringe.
